summary: Round 2 report-only revision resolves the blocking finding COLD-R1-01 and the non-blocking COLD-R1-02/03; COLD-R1-04 is deferred with an evidence-based rationale that is accurately disclosed. README.md now states the 312.5 GiB raw payload exceeds the 128 GiB request while 31.3 GiB sim10 fits, reports aggregate final residency 38.21%/39.71% raw versus 99.9975% sim10, calls this 'consistent with' page-cache reclaim and an uncontrolled memory-pressure asymmetry, and explicitly says cgroup reclaim counters were not collected so the throughput contribution is unmeasured. All of these numbers recompute exactly from 00-raw.json, 03-raw.json, 01/02-sim10.json final_cache (31315703/81947387, 32541097/81947387, 8198737/8198943). The server-cache/shared-load caveat now states all bytes were hashed or copied through this client shortly before timing (matches run.py lines 55 and 61-62), the second raw loop followed the first within minutes (NIC monotonic gap ~117 s), concurrent FFB load was not measured, and repeat differences cannot be separated from those effects. Idle range corrected to 0.93-0.98 MiB/s (0.940/0.976/0.931/0.937 from idle rx_gib_s x1024). The new job.txt (COMPLETED 0:0, 14m17, 128G, gres/gpu=4, cpu=112) is consistent with README line 23's 'allocated four GPUs, exposed/used one' and with provenance gpu_mask = first UUID plus the getDeviceCount()==1 assertion. No harness/auditor/test file content differs from what round 1 described (same line anchors in run.py and audit.py); native evidence copies, validation.json pass, complete.json, cleanup.json removed=true and tests.log 7 OK are all present. No new blocking issues; one low housekeeping item on stale round-1 status wording.
